reflection_1_context_boundary.boundary_policy: The line between permissible context and exfiltration cannot rely on individual developer instinct or late-night memory; it must be an enforced policy supported by automated pre-commit / pre-prompt scanning.
strictly_forbidden_elements: API keys, private certificates, database credentials, environment variable manifests (.env).
Customer Personally Identifiable Information (PII), raw database production dumps, and operational audit telemetry.
Core proprietary trade secrets (e.g. chip fabrication optimization recipes, proprietary trading algorithms, custom ML weights).
Executive strategy transcripts, yield metrics, unannounced patent filings, and supplier negotiations.
reflection_1_context_boundary.safe_context_rule: Abstract real implementation details into isolated interface contracts, domain schemas, and synthetic mock fixtures before providing context to external AI models.

reflection_2_the_middle_path.flaw_of_blanket_bans: A blanket ban creates 'Shadow AI' where engineers covertly paste code from personal devices to stay competitive. Total prohibition surrenders velocity to competitors.
structural_controls: Enterprise Zero-Data-Retention SLAs: Procure dedicated B2B enterprise endpoints (e.g. Azure OpenAI / Vertex AI) legally prohibiting vendor model training or prompt retention.

Automated Client-Side DLP Interceptors: Enforce IDE-level and proxy-level Data Loss Prevention (gitleaks, regex secret scrubbers) that block API keys, customer identifiers, and marked internal files before prompts touch the network.
On-Premises Air-Gapped Code Models: Host dedicated open-weight models on internal GPU clusters for top-secret fabrication, finance, or algorithmic divisions.
The 11 PM Test: Guardrails succeed only when they are automated in software. If safety depends on a tired engineer remembering not to paste code at 11 PM, the system has already failed.
